# Barceló Hotel Group

> > Global hospitality company offering luxury and all-inclusive hotels across multiple brands including Barceló Hotels & Resorts, Royal Hideaway, Occidental, and Allegro.

Barceló Hotel Group operates premium properties worldwide with a focus on beach resorts in the Caribbean (Dominican Republic, Mexico, Costa Rica), European city hotels (Spain), and luxury destinations (Maldives, Dubai, UAE). The site features destination-based hotel search, all-inclusive packages, special offers, and innovative room concepts like B-Room.

## Key Topics

- Barceló Hotels & Resorts
- Royal Hideaway luxury hotels
- Occidental Hotels & Resorts
- All-inclusive resorts
- Dominican Republic (Punta Cana, Bávaro Beach)
- México (Cozumel, Mexico City)
- Costa Rica (Gulf of Papagayo)
- España (Andalusia, Canary Islands, Balearic Islands)
- Luxury hotels (5-star properties)
- Hotel booking and reservations
- Beach resorts
- Urban hotels
- Dubai and United Arab Emirates
- Destination search
- Special offers and discounts
